observation.anchor: classifyBoundedRereviewCore, the count >= 3 term of the stall/cap stop
observation.detail: At bounded count three the stop suppresses a mandatory-full reopen (risk_shape_changed / git_lineage_changed) into handback_required. code-review-checklist scopes that handback to count three WITHOUT a reopen condition and states mandatory full MUST take priority at count three; five clauses corroborate, and the same spec classes both reopen reasons as mandatory full. origin/main returned route full at that branch because the reopen returns sat above the cap test, so this is a regression introduced by the round-1 remediation and locked by the two cap cells of the new test matrix. It also makes the change's declaration that code-review-checklist semantics are unchanged an overclaim, puts two promoted canonical specs in contradiction, and would consume the user's exact-once override for a round the spec scopes to no-reopen-condition. Scope: the count >= 3 term only; stallExhausted suppressing a reopen is this change's newly specified and correct semantics.

The rewritten closing line names only round and a non-converging stalled_rounds as blocking, but POST_PR_BLOCKING_COST_THRESHOLD_STATES also blocks on stalled_rounds in state unavailable, which is not a non-converging streak. The promoted spec and the rule leaf both name that state as blocking; this one user-facing sentence is the carrier that does not, and the advisory renders in exactly that state on the override-cleared path.

The b86f3c7b edit appended a sentence to the end of an existing one, producing a 178-character run-on line whose That guard antecedent now sits four lines earlier. The carrier is also still absent from proposal Section 2 Touch, while the same remediation round added openspec-step-1-to-9.md to Touch for the identical reason.
